what: Houses for sale listed as waterfront, by the water each listing names (a listing can name more than one), CRM active listings in aggregate (CCMLS), pulled 2026-11-04
rule: Horry County and the Georgetown County coast: South Carolina addresses, less Manning, Awendaw, Mullins and Andrews; houses unless named. Lake and pond are one set in the CRM (identical), so they are one kind here.

dock_compare.rule: listed as waterfront and naming a canal, creek, marsh, the Intracoastal Waterway or a river, and not the ocean
